corrections.original: Tasks of 50 ms or more are browser 'long tasks', and both 67 ms and 56 ms commits exceed that
corrections.fix: The frame-budget part is confirmed (web.dev: 16 ms per frame; the product uses 16.7 ms). Do not call the commits long tasks. MDN defines a long task as uninterrupted main-thread work of 50 ms or more. The 56 ms is 38.6 ms of commit plus 19.4 ms of passive effects, which React usually flushes in a later task. The 67 ms report has no phase split.
